correctness.rationale: Derived projection slope B(f)=sum c_k (f_k-f_(k-1)), c_k>0, and exact attained seminorm W max c_k/w_k by single-step jumps. Reproduction of coordinate t yields lower bound 1 and equality iff c_k=w_k/W. Differencing c_i-c_(i+1)=mu_i(t_i-m)/S forces strict rise/possible single peak flat/strict fall. Constructive masses mu_i=(w_i-w_(i+1))/(t_i-m) with endpoint delta values positive and zero-peak free mass give mean m and S=W; completeness up to scaling. Independently checked rational n=4 profile w=(1,2,1), mu=(1,3,3,1): c=(1/4,1/2,1/4), norm 1. Exact one-edge boundary included; examined check_projection.py, which does not replace proof.

evidence: Published mass-aware isotonic variation theorem classifies a nonlinear cone-constrained projection using concavity in cumulative observation mass; the present linear rank-two affine projector has a distinct inverse positive-mass design criterion in edge-weight order for every grid.
